title.zh: IMF Approves $138 Million for El Salvador After Bitcoin Waiver
title.en: IMF Approves $138 Million for El Salvador After Bitcoin Waiver

current_state.zh: The IMF approved a $138 million disbursement for El Salvador after accepting a Bitcoin waiver, while still expecting the country to halt further BTC purchases beyond documented donations and fully unwind its remaining Chivo exposure.
current_state.en: The IMF approved a $138 million disbursement for El Salvador after accepting a Bitcoin waiver, while still expecting the country to halt further BTC purchases beyond documented donations and fully unwind its remaining Chivo exposure.
